entities.summary: "Little Bad Girl" is a song by French DJ David Guetta, featuring vocals from English recording artist Taio Cruz and American rapper Ludacris. It was released for digital download from 27 June 2011 by Virgin Records, serving as the second single from Guetta's fifth studio album Nothing but the Beat. This song later appeared on Cruz's third album TY.O.
